text:
maria: Post-review a11y nit: Model Settings accordion 'loses' focus when closed. Steps: keyboard to header -> Enter -> tab into inputs -> ESC. Result: focus drops to document, users must tab a lot. Expectation: focus returns to header trigger.

avni: Also: when save shows validation errors inside panel, screen readers don't get a summary. Either move focus to first invalid field or update an aria-live region: '1 error in Model tuning'.

tyler: Small UX: header should respond to Space + Enter, and consider arrow-key navigation between headers for long lists.

maria: Implementation notes: header button must have aria-expanded toggled, aria-controls to panel id, panel role=region + aria-labelledby. On open focus first control; on close focus header. Modal opened from inside panel should return to modal opener on close (not the header).

design-bot: Auto-check: focus-outline token fails contrast on dark bg (#0f172a) at 2px. Recommend a11y-focus-strong or 3px outline.

sam: I'll add acceptance criteria to ticket: focus return, aria attributes, role/labeling, error announcement, optional roving keys, axe + visual checks in light/dark. Will add Storybook examples and e2e tab-flow test.

jim: I'll take the frontend PR. ETA next Tue.

maria: QA voiceover script to attach: tab -> open -> invalidate -> save -> listen for announcement -> ESC -> confirm header focus. LMK edge cases (virtualized lists, nested traps).
